layout.title: Alex - The Guardian | Vertex 4D
layout.directionText: Problem lens ProblemFrame Next action Save a ProblemFrame. Why it matters The rest of the chain should not reason from a vague or solution-shaped problem. What VERTEX should reveal Whether the team is solving a real problem or describing a preferred solution. Where this goes SynapMap, Approval Gate, DecisionRecord, Decision Memo Soft gate: weak framing can continue, but the risk remains visible.

layout.title: SynapMap - The Visionary | Vertex 4D
layout.directionText: System lens SystemMap Next action Save a SystemMap with payer, approver, blocker and dependencies. Why it matters Adoption depends on more than the user; the decision lives in a stakeholder system. What VERTEX should reveal Who can make the decision work, approve it, pay for it, or block it. Where this goes Approval Gate, D-Predict, Billie, facilitator intervention radar Soft gate: missing authority paths become inte
visibleHeadings:

layout.title: Assumption Approval | VERTEX 4D
layout.directionText: Evidence gate Approved assumption register Next action Approve only assumptions that are allowed to feed D-Predict or Billie. Why it matters Unreviewed assumptions must not travel downstream disguised as facts. What VERTEX should reveal Which beliefs are evidence-backed, which are assumptions, and what still needs proof. Where this goes PredictiveHypothesis, FinancialScenario, DecisionRecord traceability Hard gate fo
visibleHeadings:

layout.title: Billie - Pricing & 10-Year Projection | Vertex 4D
layout.directionText: Economic lens FinancialScenario Next action Create a FinancialScenario from explicit founder assumptions. Why it matters Before committing resources, check whether price, margin and cost structure can survive. What VERTEX should reveal Whether the current price intuition conflicts with variable cost, volume or runway. Where this goes DecisionRecord, Decision Memo, Outcome Report pricing movement Soft gate: weak numbe
visibleHeadings:

screens.title: Student workspace: DecisionRecord
screens.description: Student converts the reviewed chain into a bounded next commitment.

layout.title: DecisionRecord - Vertex 4D
layout.directionText: Commitment lens DecisionRecord Next action Create and save a DecisionRecord. Why it matters The analysis must collapse into a bounded next commitment without hiding uncertainty. What VERTEX should reveal What changed from the baseline belief and what still remains uncertain. Where this goes Decision Memo, facilitator review, Cohort Outcome Report Commit gate: hypotheses stay labelled; the final decision records prove
visibleHeadings:

Ahora firma la decisión.
